subject: Phased cutover amendment + rollback clause — coordination and legal redlines
messages:
From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fluxhealth.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Shaw <evan.shaw@fluxhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Phased cutover amendment request + rollback protections

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to move forward but need a short amendment to the MSA/order form to capture the phased cutover schedule and an explicit rollback exhibit in case the live run triggers material regression. Key asks from our side: 

- Formalize a 3-stage cutover: pilot (small traffic), ramp (50%), and full (100%) with dates and success metrics.
- Add rollback conditions tied to latency/error thresholds and a 24-hour rollback window.
- Preserve the originally quoted price for pilot and ramp stages; any surge pricing triggers require 14-day notice.

Can you share a draft amendment and confirm whether Redwood can attach a runbook exhibit for operational rollback? Attached is our internal timeline (Cutover-Runbook.pdf).

Best,
Priya
Product Ops, FluxHealth

Attachments: Cutover-Runbook.pdf (PDF, 88KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fluxhealth.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased cutover amendment request + rollback protections

Priya —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can do a targeted amendment + exhibit rather than reworking the MSA fully. Next steps from our side: 

1) I will spin up a draft amendment that captures the 3-stage schedule, explicit rollback triggers, and the pricing commitment for pilot/ramp.
2) Laura (legal ops) will review the rollback wording to ensure it's operationally actionable and consistent with our SLA and change-order processes.
3) Karthik and I will work on an operational exhibit (rollback-exhibit-proposal.pdf) that includes the cutover checklist and the technical rollback steps.

Can you confirm your preferred success metrics for ramp -> full? Typical thresholds we see used: P99 latency increase > 50% vs baseline or error rate > 3% for 30 minutes. If you have different tolerances, tell us now so we include them in the draft.

I'll circulate a first-pass amendment by EOD Wednesday PST.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Amendment-Draft-v1.docx (DOCX, draft)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Phased cutover amendment request + rollback protections

Marcus / Karthik —

Looping legal ops in early. A few legal notes for the amendment draft: 

- "Rollback" should be scoped to production-facing incidents only and avoid capturing expected behavior during early pilot (we can define a separate pilot acceptance clause).
- Propose a 48-hour standstill for billing adjustments after a rollback event to give both sides time to remediate; this avoids immediate financial churn.
- We should add an explicit clause that Redwood's liability does not expand beyond existing limits as a result of the exhibit.

Monica — could you please add an implementation schedule appendix and short signoff checklist for engineering leads? That will make the rollback process auditable.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 10:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Priya —
> ...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fluxhealth.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased cutover amendment request + rollback protections

Priya —

Thanks for the runbook. From an ops perspective I want to highlight two technical constraints that should be reflected in the exhibit: 

1) Cold-start variability: during pilot we may see occasional P99 spikes; the rollback trigger should be accompanied by a "stabilization window" (we suggest 45 minutes) to avoid flip-flopping.
2) KV cache warm-up: full traffic may see degraded tail latency until KV caches are primed — recommend excluding the first 30 minutes of ramping from automatic rollback triggers and treating it as a warm-up window.

I've attached a short technical annex for inclusion in the exhibit. Happy to walk through it with your SREs.

Karthik
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rollback-exhibit-proposal.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@fluxhealth.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased cutover amendment request + rollback protections

Thanks team — all sensible items. Quick clarifications from FluxHealth: 

- Accept the 45 minute stabilization window and 30 minute cache warm-up exclusion.
- For success metrics we'll accept: P99 latency increase > 50% for 30 minutes OR error rate > 2.5% for 20 minutes.
- We prefer the 24-hour rollback execution window (Flux ops wants the ability to rollback quickly if user impact is observed), but can accept the 48-hour billing standstill Laura proposed. Can you include the two together: 24-hour technical rollback action; 48-hour billing standstill for pricing disputes.

If you can send updated redlines with those items incorporated, we'll run through legal and bring our procurement/legal for final signoff.

Best,
Priya

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 11:46 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased cutover amendment request + rollback protections

Priya —

Attached is a revised amendment (Redwood-Amendment-Draft-v1.docx) and the rollback exhibit (rollback-exhibit-proposal.pdf) reflecting the stabilization window, cache warm-up exclusion, the agreed triggers, and the 24/48 timing split (24-hour technical rollback; 48-hour billing standstill).

A few practical notes: 

- Implementation appendix (Monica) includes signoff matrix and point-of-contact table so we can quickly execute the rollback.
- Laura's liability language is included to keep overall caps unchanged.
- We propose a short clause describing a 14-day notice for any surge pricing after the pilot/ramp phases.

Please confirm target procurement/legal reviewers on your side so we can route the DocuSign once internal approvals are complete.

If all looks good I'll lock the doc and send DocuSign early next week.

Thanks — looking forward to cutting over.

Marcus
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Amendment-Draft-v1.docx; rollback-exhibit-proposal.pdf
